title: 15-Min Sweet Chilli Falafel Pitas
subtitle: On the table in a flash!
description: Leave it to us to make weeknight cooking even simpler and faster. Amped with a variety of brilliant ready-to-go ingredients to make life easier, you’ll love how quick and downright good this 15-minute recipe is!

steps.text: Fry falafel: Check your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe (see Kitchen hack). Heat a generous drizzle of olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Fry the falafel, turning regularly, for 3-5 mins until golden. Remove from the pan. Put the sweet chilli sauce in a small frypan over medium heat. Cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until warm. Remove from the heat and cover to keep warm.

Make avo yoghurt and slaw: Coarsely mash the avocado in a bowl. Add the yoghurt, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Combine 1 tbs mayonnaise and 1 tsp water in a separate large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the kaleslaw mix and toss to combine.

Warm pita and serve up: Halve the pita to form 4 pockets. Put on a plate, slightly overlapping, and microwave for 30 secs or until warmed through. Fill the pita with some kaleslaw and avo yoghurt, then add the falafel and drizzle with the sweet chilli sauce. Scatter with the dukkah and serve with the remaining kaleslaw and avo yoghurt. Enjoy!

Kitchen hack: To speed up the ripening process, put the avocado in a paper bag and loosely close, then leave on the kitchen bench for a day or two. Add a banana to the bag to make the avocado ripen faster.
